text:
maya: Quick RFC follow-up — thinking about a 'soft onramp' for new tenants to reduce cold-start abuse. Idea: give a small burst pool for first N minutes tied to behavioral signals, then auto-transition into regular quotas. Looking for thoughts on interface boundaries (ingress -> admission -> quota) and attack vectors.

samir: Main risk is churn abuse: attacker creates many tenants to harvest bursts. How do we tie onramp to something hard to spoof? billing, org age, fingerprinting?

tess: For self-serve, prefer progressive ramping: start small (2k tokens), then increase after low-anomaly windows. Require billing verification for larger bursts.

maya: Interface sketch: admission API returns an onramp_grant blob so callers don't implement logic. e.g. onramp_grant: allowed, tokens, expires_at, telemetry_id — admission owns lifecycle.

ev an: Our abuse-detector is async/batched; admission can't get a fresh score per-request without latency.

samir: Hybrid approach: cached risk score with TTL + fast heuristics in admission (churn, IP velocity). If cached score high, deny onramp.

tess: Tradeoffs: sync checks increase p99 for new tenants. I prefer cached + bloom-fast checks. Also make onramp token bucket have higher penalty drain on suspicious signals.

maya: Example response shape (stringified): {"onramp_grant":true, "tokens":2000, "window_secs":600, "escalate_after_windows":3, "telemetry_id":"onramp-2026-03"} — keeps admission->quota boundary clear: admission issues grant, quota enforces.

ev an: Suggestion: abuse service provide a short-lived risk_token (fast path) admission can include in grant; abuse service keeps lightweight cache keyed by org_id.

samir: Ops metrics to add: onramp_hits, onramp_rejections, escalations, burst_consumed_per_tenant, reenabled_by_human. Dashboards + alerts if rejections spike.

maya: Rollout plan: feature-flagged, enable for internal/test orgs, then small % of new signups. Auto-disable per-org on suspicious signals. Runbook for revoking grants and SRE escalation.

infra-bot: deploybot: starting rollout of feature-flag redwood.onramp.v1 -> staging :rocket:

samir: Also add backstop: global guard in edge proxy that caps onramp rate per IP/netblock to catch mass tenant creation.

tess: I'll draft the RFC + sample dashboard. @maya please add the API proto + a quick simulation of burst economics.

maya: Will do — drafting now and tagging you both. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
